messages:
olivia: Quick follow-up from PM-2024-066 (service restart cascade). We left with action items but no clear owners/timeline. Need: infra owner, test owner, and a RACI + target close date.
tarek: I'll own the infra change ticket. will create INF-4220 and add rollback steps + canary plan. ETA: PR by Thu.
sasha: I'll own INF-4221 for the regression tests and nightly smoke. will add replay traces from the incident and a mem-leak detector. ETA: Mon next week.
pm-bot: Postmortem logged: PM-2024-066. Reminder: link remediation tickets and mark owners.
infra-oncall: RACI suggestion: tarek = R, sasha = A, olivia = C, infra-oncall = I. If vendor kernel tweak required, loop in infra-vendor.
tarek: INF-4220 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4220 - assigned. adding acceptance criteria: no restart cascade on 6h soak, <1% error delta, rollback steps. snippet in ticket: `systemctl restart --no-block redwood-workers` and canary script reference.
sasha: INF-4221 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4221 - assigned. attaching traces and test harness. kicked off first replay now.
olivia: Target: close both tickets within 2 sprints. If blocked, escalate in weekly ops sync.
infra-oncall: noted. please keep updates in ticket comments vs thread. we'll review RACI at next follow-up.
tarek: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/701 - feature-flagged change + canary. will post canary report here.
sasha: first replay shows improvement on error spikes, will iterate and post results in INF-4221.
pm-bot: INF-4220 transitioned to In Progress by tarek.
olivia: thanks everyone — loop back here when tests pass and we can close the loop.
